description: cfd_2d_still_amr with G 29 1: the pressure of the covered cells restricted relative to the hydrostatic pressure of each grid (cfd_amr::restrict_press_hydro). At rest the coarse cells under the patch keep the hydrostatic pressure of the coarse grid across the free surface, the patch edge stays at rest (max |u| about 1e-9 m/s instead of 1e-3 m/s after 2 s in the long run).
